question: what does 剪映 change when it opens a CLI-built draft and saves it?

semantics_preserved.segment_timing: target start 0 omitted (equivalent), duration 2000000 kept; source_timerange null on a text segment

consequence_for_the_cli: a draft_resource receipt records the node digest and the draft digest, so any editor save invalidates it: the ids are regenerated and fps/source/created_via disappear. Receipts therefore have to be built from a draft the editor does not own, or after the editor's final save - not across it.
